# StorenTech AI

> StorenTech AI is a full-service AI agency in Orange County, California. Every client starts with a paid AI Opportunity Map that shows where time and revenue leak and which AI fixes pay off first. StorenTech AI then builds AI agents with clear limits and a person approving anything risky.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.storentechai.com/): We find where time and revenue leak in your business, then fix what pays. People stay in the loop.
- [AI Opportunity Map](https://www.storentechai.com/opportunity): A paid analysis of where time, revenue, and risk leak, and what's worth fixing first.
- [Work](https://www.storentechai.com/work): Map the leaks first, then a Build Plan, with people still in the loop and out front with customers.
- [How it works](https://www.storentechai.com/how-it-works): Start with the paid AI Opportunity Map, then the Build Plan, then the build.
- [Blog](https://www.storentechai.com/blog): Plain-English guides for business owners who are new to AI agents and automation.
- [About](https://www.storentechai.com/about): StorenTech AI is a full-service AI agency based in Orange County, California.
- [Contact](https://www.storentechai.com/contact): Book your AI Opportunity Map through the contact form.
